articles.title: Goldman Staff in Hong Kong Lose Access to Anthropic’s Claude
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s staff in Hong Kong no longer have access to Anthropic’s Claude, an AI agent that speeds the process of writing computer software, according to a person familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Stocks Fall as Report on OpenAI Fuels Angst | The Close 4/28/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. articles.title: We still need developer communities
articles.summary: Ryan welcomes Mike Swift, co-founder and CEO of Major League Hacking, to the show to chat about the never-ending need for software developer communities and entry points into programming; MHL’s recent acquisition of DEV and how they’re creating a place for shared knowledge, building, and publishing; and why now is the best time to be both an artisan and a builder in a world with AI software development tools.
articles.author: Phoebe Sajor
